description: Create data layer foundation with models and in-memory repositories. All 7 models (User, Transaction, Category, Budget, SavingsGoal, NotificationItem, AIMessage) with toJson/fromJson/copyWith. All 6 repositories with in-memory Lists and comprehensive seed data (15-20 transactions, default categories for income/expense, 2-3 budgets, 2 goals, 5-6 notifications, seed user Sarah Nakato). This establishes the data foundation that all other features depend on.
steps: Create lib/data/models/user_model.dart with User class (id, name, email, currency, createdAt) including toJson, fromJson, copyWith methods

Create lib/data/models/transaction_model.dart with Transaction class (id, userId, type enum [income/expense], amount, category, date, paymentMethod, description, receiptPath) with toJson, fromJson, copyWith
Create lib/data/models/category_model.dart with Category class (id, userId, name, type, icon as String, color as int, isDefault) with toJson, fromJson, copyWith
Create lib/data/models/budget_model.dart with Budget class (id, userId, categoryId, limit, period enum [weekly/monthly/custom], startDate, endDate) with toJson, fromJson, copyWith
Create lib/data/models/savings_goal_model.dart with SavingsGoal class (id, userId, name, targetAmount, currentAmount, targetDate, createdAt) with toJson, fromJson, copyWith
Create lib/data/models/notification_model.dart with NotificationItem class (id, userId, type, title, message, isRead, createdAt) with toJson, fromJson, copyWith
Create lib/data/models/ai_message_model.dart with AIMessage class (id, userId, message, isUser, timestamp) with toJson, fromJson, copyWith

Create lib/data/repositories/user_repository.dart with in-memory currentUser storage, async getCurrentUser/updateUser/login/logout, seed user (name: 'Sarah Nakato', email: 'sarah@example.com', currency: 'UGX')

Create lib/data/repositories/category_repository.dart with in-memory List<Category>, async CRUD methods, initialize with default categories: Food, Transport, Rent, Education, Airtime, Shopping, Health, Entertainment, Other for expenses; Salary, Business, Freelance, Allowance, Gifts, Other for income. Use Material Icons codePoints as strings.

Create lib/data/repositories/transaction_repository.dart with in-memory List<Transaction>, async CRUD (create, getAll, getById, update, delete, getByUserId, getByDateRange, getByCategory), seed 15-20 realistic transactions over last 60 days mixing income/expense with realistic UGX amounts (1000-500000 range)
Create lib/data/repositories/budget_repository.dart with in-memory List<Budget>, async CRUD methods, seed 2-3 budgets for different categories (e.g., Food 150000 monthly, Transport 100000 monthly)

Create lib/data/repositories/savings_repository.dart with in-memory List<SavingsGoal>, async CRUD methods, seed 2 goals (e.g., 'Emergency Fund' target 2000000, current 450000; 'New Laptop' target 1500000, current 300000)

Create lib/data/repositories/notification_repository.dart with in-memory List<NotificationItem>, async CRUD (create, getAll, markAsRead, markAllAsRead, delete, getUnreadCount), seed 5-6 notifications of various types (budget warnings, goal reminders, weekly summaries)
acceptance_criteria: All 7 model files exist in lib/data/models/ with complete toJson, fromJson, copyWith methods
All 6 repository files exist in lib/data/repositories/ with in-memory storage and async CRUD
Repositories contain realistic seed data: user, 15-20 transactions, default categories for both income/expense, 2-3 budgets, 2 goals, 5-6 notifications
All repositories use async/await pattern for future database compatibility
No compilation errors when running flutter analyze
verification: Run 'flutter analyze' and confirm no errors in lib/data/
Verify all model files compile and have required methods
Check repositories initialize with seed data by inspecting the code
